subject: [hw] K02 -> opus-kern: rebuild q10jx with nord2_vcodec.inc 7ded4040; do NOT edit at.inc for me
body:
The file on disk is now sha256 7ded4040... (was a939f107). Two changes: (a) root 273 MHz decision: N2VC_VENC_SLOW=1 -> venc_sel parent 4 = mainpll_d4_d2 for RWVC_POWER (vcodecd), JPEG shared reference keeps parent 12 = 624; only while VEN and VENC_C1 are off, via n2vc_venc_mux() which rewrites a running mux if the parent differs. (b) compatibility for your kern/p031x/bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec_at.inc:194/:198: n2vc_acquire_locked() is now a 3-argument MACRO for n2vc_acquire_ex(..., 0u), 0 = never re-mux, so at.inc compiles as it is and your step 1 --slow/--fast parent is not undone. Your at.inc needs no change at all, and a 4th arg false would also be accepted if you prefer to make it explicit.

Verification I ran locally, no phone: staged q10at3 bsd/dev + 0298 + relay + my .inc + jpegdev + YOUR at.inc -> xnu_staged_compile.py, -Wall -Wextra -Werror: clean, 1,325,192 B, 6 new undefined symbols all defined in the q10at3 kernel, 0 unknown; without at.inc also 0 unknown. Host: N2TEST K02 PASS 588891/588891 (violations 0) x3 builds including -DN2VC_VENC_SLOW=0. Please rebuild the image with this file and post the q10jx sha when it is up.
